    • Severe Incidence and Mortality

Adjust severe rates as a result of treatment coverage and estimate mortality disaggregated by hospitalised and community

severe_incidence_mortality.Rd

SeeGriffin et al (2016) SI for more details

Usage

severe_incidence_mortality(
  x,
  treatment_scaler,
  hosp_sev_cfr,
  community_sev_cfr
)

Arguments

x

Input data.frame

treatment_scaler

Proportion of treated severe cases averted by treatment

hosp_sev_cfr

Severe case fatality ratio in hospital The original estimate fitted to Reyburn et al data in Griffin et al (2016) 0.065

community_sev_cfr

Severe case fatality ratio in the commnity (non-hospitalised) The original estimate fitted to Lubell et al data in Griffin et al (2016) 0.6
